description: Matches a natural-language question (e.g. "can I buy Tesla as a token", "best stablecoin yield on Base", "euro stablecoins MiCA", "pre-IPO OpenAI token") against TokenBank answer pages. Returns the best-matching questions with the first sentence of each computed answer (figures from the live dataset), the page URL and a JSON URL with every row, plus matching guides (e.g. how to verify a contract, what happens if an issuer fails), each with a JSON URL. Questions in Arabic, German, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese or Indonesian also return pages written in that language (localPages).
name: find_answer
title: Find an answer page
